Omlette & Potato Rolls

Quick, simple and easy rolls that taste delightful!

5 minPreparation
5 minCooking
1Servings

Ingredients

For 1 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Lay a paratha on a work surface. Spread half the Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup on the paratha and arrange half the potato slices on top.
  2. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a pan and pour 1 beaten egg into the hot oil.
  3. Cook for 1 minute, turn over and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons grated cheese. Cook for 30 seconds or until set.
  4. Place the omelette on one paratha. Top with 1 teaspoon cheese and a dollop of ketchup. Roll up to enclose the filling and serve immediately. Repeat with the remaining egg and paratha.
